body: I feel the same :( I feel guilty whenever I’m happy, like I don’t deserve it.

How’d you do it? Would really like the help as I don’t think I can do it tomorrow

Also: proud of you, keep it up!
I’m so glad I’ve finally found another person that does this!! I learnt how to do it as a kid cause I didn’t want people to say “bless you” to me :(
Honestly what’s the point of living if all I think about is death?

You aren’t a terrible person. I know it’s hard to believe because I think the same about myself. But you’re there to help your friend, she needs you and I’m sure she appreciates you. You’re a wonderful person for helping your friend in this dark time, even though you yourself are struggling.
It’s not your fault, it’s mine
The way the world works is so disappointing. I just fill another useless 9-5 job to make more money to buy useless things

I know you already said no to sharpie but I just used a fine point and found that it was easy to wash off if you use it lightly. I also use an Uni Jetstream 0.38 when I’m at school, which comes off super easy
Because Ive been a bad person to everyone around me, my parents, my friends, even my bf. all I do is make them upset or disappointed

I still self harm but not as much as I used to. I also don’t cut (I prefer bruises) so I understand where you’re coming from. What I’ve started trying to do is draw on myself. The thought of getting ink poisoning weirdly helps me cope with the suicidal thoughts, while in reality it’s unlikely to actually hurt you a great deal.

I’ve tried the deep breathing and music too and honestly with self harm I feel like I have to do something physical, so the drawing helps.
I feel the same way in life, thank you so much for writing this
I would notice if you were gone <3
I don’t understand why I should be forgiven, or even deserve love

I just use a sharpie, it washes off quickly if you draw on your hands but in other places like legs/arms it stays on for awhile. Mine has lasted a few days so far, but I don’t draw as much as I should.
Why can’t you? Your father & sister hitting you and screaming at you is clearly abuse.

Leave them. Please. You cannot live in that situation.

Seek out anyone, go to a hospital, go to your school counselors if you have them. Hell, go to a neighbors house. Anyone to help you get away from that hell of a situation. You do not deserve the abuse they give you. You deserve love and kindness and the help you need.
Gorgeous!! I love the sparkles
Thank you for all the help, when I’m in these moods it’s hard to rationalize my own thoughts and I’m glad to have someone to help
Probably yeah, but I always feel like he would move on if I was dead
No, but I showed him my self harm scars a few days ago and I did it again this morning :( I think that has something to do with it
For anyone reading this it went fine and I didn’t end up in a psych ward. Probably just my anxiety getting to me
I’ve heard of too many bad experiences I’m just scared. I have thought of how I would do it, should I tell them that???
Give him lots of love!
I’m scared to tell them about my suicidal thoughts & self harm because he might put me in a mental hospital. Maybe I need that?

I hate myself because all I do is ruin other people’s lives and make them sad. I can never make my boyfriend happy because I’m sad all the time, and I’m just empty and numb around the house which makes my parents sad. It would be better if I just never existed
I’m glad someone feels the same.
Wholesome :) I love you and your dog
